999008199.text: ニーナさん。こ、ここはどこなんでしょう？
レ、レイニャたち……どうしてこんなことに……

localizations.en: H-how did we end up in this situation...

999008199.text: はぁ。誤解があったことだけは確かね……

localizations.en: Well... There's clearly been some kind of misunderstanding...

999008199.text:
そこの新入りさん！
しゃべってないでキッチリ運んでください！

localizations.en: Hey, newbie! Less chatting, more carrying!

999008199.text:
とにかく今は、誰でもいいから手を借りたいほど
忙しいんだ。頑張って運んでくれよ！

localizations.en: We're so busy right now we'll take help from anyone we can get. Keep those supplies moving!

999008199.text:
調査団に入りたいと言ったのは君たちです。
これも星の導き、たくさん働いてもらいますよ

localizations.en: You're the ones who said you wanted to join the survey team. It must be the stars' guidance—now get to work!

999008199.text:
レ、レイニャたちが調査団なのに。ただ、調査団の
拠点までの道を聞いただけなのに……

localizations.en: B-but we're already part of the survey team! We just asked for directions to the base...

999008199.text: 嘆いても仕方ないわよ

localizations.en: No use complaining about it now.

999008199.text:
よく分からないけど、ここで調査団といえば、
彼らのことみたいだし……

localizations.en: I don't quite get it, but around here it seems when people say 'survey team,' they mean these folks...

999008199.text:
見知らぬ土地で無一文。だったら、ここにいれば
食べるのには困らないわよね

localizations.en: We're broke in a strange land. At least this way we won't have to worry about food.

999008199.text: さ、さすがニーナさん。肝が据わってます

localizations.en: T-that's a good point. You're so level-headed.

999008199.text:
しかも……要領がいいです？
なぜか割り当てられた荷物も少ないですし

localizations.en: And somehow... they've given you way less cargo than everyone else...

999008199.text:
ほらほら！　働かざる者食うべからずだ！
本部までもうちょっとだ！　頑張れよ！

localizations.en: Come on, come on! Those who don't work don't eat! We're almost at headquarters! Keep at it!

999008199.text:
アラディス調査団の一員で、元傭兵。
謎めいた雰囲気だが、愉快でお茶目な一面もある

localizations.en: Nina Friede - A member of the Aladiss Research Team and former mercenary. Despite her mysterious aura, she has a cheerful and playful side.

999008199.text:
アラディス調査団所属。亜人種「ウェルクス」の少女。
実力はあるが、小心者で自分に自信がない

localizations.en: A member of the Aladiss Research Team and a Welleks demihuman. Though capable, she lacks confidence and is rather timid.
